record.paper_title: Recent developments and open problems in the theory of permanents
record.original_question: Let A be an n x n positive semidefinite matrix and let 1 <= k <= n-1. Let G_{k,n} be the set of strictly increasing functions from {1,...,k} to {1,...,n}. For alpha,beta in G_{k,n}, let A[alpha,beta] be the k x k submatrix of A with rows indexed by alpha and columns indexed by beta, and let A(alpha,beta) be the complementary (n-k) x (n-k) submatrix. Define C_k(A) to be the matrix indexed by G_{k,n} with entry per(A(alpha,beta)) per(A[alpha,beta]) at (alpha,beta). Is per(A) the largest eigenvalue of C_k(A) for every k=1,...,n-1?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A$ be an $n\times n$ positive semidefinite Hermitian matrix, and fix an integer $k$ with $1\le k\le n-1$. Let $G_{k,n}$ denote the set of strictly increasing functions from $\{1,\dots,k\}$ to $\{1,\dots,n\}$ (equivalently, the set of $k$-element subsets of $\{1,\dots,n\}$ listed in increasing order). For $\alpha,\beta\in G_{k,n}$, let $A[\alpha,\beta]$ denote the $k\times k$ submatrix of $A$ obtained by selecting the rows indexed by $\alpha$ and the columns indexed by $\beta$, and let $A(\alpha,\beta)$ denote the complementary $(n-k)\times(n-k)$ submatrix obtained by deleting the rows indexed by $\alpha$ and the columns indexed by $\beta$. Let $\operatorname{per}$ denote the permanent. Define the matrix $C_k(A)$, indexed by $G_{k,n}\times G_{k,n}$, by
$$\bigl(C_k(A)\bigr)_{\alpha,\beta} \;=\; \operatorname{per}\bigl(A(\alpha,\beta)\bigr)\,\operatorname{per}\bigl(A[\alpha,\beta]\bigr).$$
Prove or disprove: for every such $A$ and every $k\in\{1,\dots,n-1\}$, $\operatorname{per}(A)$ is the largest eigenvalue of $C_k(A)$.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature (including a 2025 preprint exploring logical implications between this and related permanent conjectures, and surveys/updates on permanent conjectures) treats Pate's permanental compound eigenvalue conjecture as still open: it is known that per(A) is an eigenvalue of C_k(A), but whether it is always the largest eigenvalue for positive semidefinite A has not been established or refuted.

status_evidence.title: A logical implication between two conjectures on matrix permanents
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Pate's conjecture that per(A) is the largest eigenvalue of C_k(A) as an open problem and explores its relation to other permanent conjectures.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is treated as currently unresolved.

status_evidence.title: An update on a few permanent conjectures
status_evidence.snippet: Survey lists Pate's conjecture among open permanent conjectures alongside Lieb's permanental dominance and others.
status_evidence.claim: Listed as an active open conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Lieb's permanental dominance conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on related permanental dominance problems does not report a resolution of Pate's compound eigenvalue conjecture.
